shell.accountNotReadyBody: Your substitute account is not linked yet. Use the invited email address or contact the network administrator.
shell.pickWorker: Pick which worker you are previewing locally.
shell.noWorkersSeeded: No workers exist yet. Seed the database first.

home.emptyBody: Requests come in based on your availability. The more up to date it is, the more offers you receive.

schedule.emptyBody: Confirmed shifts will show up here.
schedule.checkInHint: Tap to check in when you arrive on site. Location is captured if granted.
schedule.checkOutHint: On shift for {elapsed}. Tap Done when you leave.
schedule.checkInMissedHint: This shift has ended. Your coordinator can enter your hours.
schedule.checkOutMissedHint: The check-out window has closed. Your coordinator can correct your hours.

notifications.emptyState: No notifications yet. They appear here once you're matched to a coverage request.

bodies.notSelected: Another substitute was chosen for {title} in {city}
bodies.cancelled: Your assignment for {title} in {city} was cancelled

push.title: Push notifications
push.enableSub: Get notified the moment a shift goes out — even when the app is closed.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for Staffig in your browser settings.
push.error: Couldn't enable notifications. Please try again.
push.iosTitle: Install the app to get alerts
push.iosBody: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. Open Staffig from your home screen and turn alerts on here.

onboarding.welcomeBlurb: Pick the cities you can cover. Coordinators only see you for requests in these places.
onboarding.citiesHint: Add every city you can realistically commute to.
onboarding.credentialsBlurb: Add what you hold. Coordinators filter on these when a request has specific requirements.
onboarding.languagesBlurb: Pick the language you're comfortable working in. Coordinators match this against the request.
onboarding.countCities: {n, plural, =0 {No cities yet} one {# city selected} other {# cities selected}}
onboarding.countCredentials: {n, plural, =0 {None added (optional)} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
onboarding.orgsBlurb: Pick the organizations you want to work with. No selection = you'll receive shifts from every organization in the network. You can change this anytime in Availability.
onboarding.countOrgs: {n, plural, one {# organization selected} other {# organizations selected}}

availability.info: When unavailable, you won't be matched to new requests. You can still see ones already sent to you.
availability.citiesInfo: Only requests in these cities will be matched to you.
availability.notifyFarSub: Notify me for requests beyond my usual area
availability.notifyWeekendOvernightSub: Notify me for overnight shifts on weekends
availability.smsAlertsSub: Turn this off to stop texts. You'll still get email and app alerts.
availability.slotsAvailable: {n, plural, =0 {No slot available} one {# slot available} other {# slots available}}

requests.unavailableNotice: You are unavailable. Set your availability to receive new requests.
requests.filledByOther: This request has been filled by another substitute.
requests.confirmModalSub: Your response will be sent to the coordinator for final confirmation.
requests.subtitleNew: Pick a shift that matches your skills and location.
requests.subtitleAccepted: Your responses are being reviewed by coordinators.

confirmModal.body: By confirming, you're telling the coordinator you can take this shift. They'll confirm shortly.

requestDetail.alreadyAccepted: You've accepted this shift. The coordinator will confirm soon.
requestDetail.declineSub: Pick a reason so the coordinator knows what's going on. You can add a note if it helps.

declineReason.notQualified: I don't have the required qualification

requestDetail.declineNotesPlaceholder: Anything else the coordinator should know? (optional)
requestDetail.modifiedBanner: This shift was updated since you last viewed it — please review the details below.
requestDetail.replacementRace: First come, first served — claim it before someone else does.
requestDetail.replacementWon: It's yours — see your shift details.
requestDetail.replacementLost: Already covered. Someone got there first — we'll alert you for the next shift.

requestAccepted.successSub: Your response is on its way to the coordinator.
requestAccepted.endedMissed: This shift ended without a recorded check-in. Your coordinator can record your hours.
requestAccepted.endedUnclosed: This shift ended without a recorded check-out. Your coordinator can correct your hours.
requestAccepted.alreadyAssigned: This shift is confirmed. Withdraw is no longer available.
requestAccepted.handedOff: You released this shift — it's now covered.
requestAccepted.released: Broadcast to the pool. The shift is still yours until someone claims it — you'll be notified the moment it's covered.
requestAccepted.releaseSheetSub: We'll alert eligible substitutes. The first to accept takes it — and it stays yours until then.
requestAccepted.replWaitingSub: Eligible substitutes have been alerted. The shift is still yours until someone takes it.
requestAccepted.replFilled: {name} took the shift — you're free. Thanks for giving notice.

absence.title: Report an absence
absence.sub: Can't make an upcoming shift? Describe it and we'll find a replacement from the pool.
absence.required: Site, role and date are required.
absence.pastDate: That shift is already in the past — pick an upcoming date.
absence.noSites: No sites are set up for self-serve replacement yet.
absence.filled: {name} is covering it — thank you for the notice.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.hintOpen: No selection — you receive shifts from every organization in the network. Tap to limit yourself to specific ones.
organizations.hintRestricted: You only receive shifts from the selected organizations. Deselect all = every organization.

signIn.title: Sign in to Staffig
signIn.blurb: Staffig is invite-only — use the email your coordinator used to invite you.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.blurb: Use the same email address your coordinator invited you with — it links your account automatically.

notInvited.title: You haven't been invited yet.
notInvited.blurb: Staffig is invite-only — coordinators add substitutes one at a time so the right people get the right shifts.
notInvited.signedInAs: You signed in as {email}, but we don't have a record of that address.
notInvited.noRecord: We don't have a record of the address you signed in with.
notInvited.way1Title: Sign in with a different account.
notInvited.way1Body: If your coordinator invited you, they used a specific email — check it.
notInvited.way2Title: Ask your organization to invite you.
notInvited.way2Body: Send them this address and they'll add you from their Staffig account.

live.offline: Connection lost — showing the last known state.

profile.title: My profile
profile.phoneHint: Used for no-show alerts by SMS.
profile.noPhone: No number yet — SMS alerts can't reach you.
